newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Noyabrskneftegaz Q1 oil output falls yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russian Noyabrskneftegaz Q1 oil output falls yr/yr.

text.p: Russian oil company AO Noyabrskneftegaz produced 4.43 million tonnes of oil (354,400 barrels per day) in the first quarter of 1997, down four percent from the same year-ago period, holding company Sibneft said in a statement.
Noyabrskneftegaz is Sibneft's main production unit.

A Sibneft spokesman said the company believed it was possible to reverse falling production this year. He said Noyabrskneftegaz planned to produced 18.7-18.9 million tonnes (374-378,000 bpd) in 1997 as a whole.
Noyabrskneftegaz produced 18.61 million tonnes (372,200 bpd) of oil in 1996, down nearly nine percent from the previous year.
Sibneft's Omsk refinery, one of Russia's largest, processed 3.72 million tonnes of oil (297,600 bpd) during the first quarter of 1997, up slightly from the same year-ago period.
